critical_code_review_comments: Header source string is lowercase 'v9 Longevity Engine' in Planner.jsx line 39; the user-facing requirement of 'V9' is satisfied only because CSS class 'label-cap' applies text-transform:uppercase. If that CSS is ever changed the brand wording would silently regress. Consider hard-coding the string as 'V9 Longevity Engine' to remove the dependency.

Optimizer tab does not expose a discrete 'Find Optimal' button — recommendation is reactive to the bracket slider. This is functionally correct but the review-request bullet implies a button; document the UX so it isn't mistaken for a missing control.

Projection re-run is debounced 350ms via useEffect on every scenario change which causes /api/project to fire twice in quick succession (with and without Roth). Consider batching the two calls or memoizing payload to reduce backend load when users type rapidly.

PlanInputs uses JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)) for deep-clone on every keystroke — fine at current scale but will become a perf concern as scenario grows; structuredClone is a faster modern alternative.
